scientific_integrity: All asymptotic results are proved analytically; finite precision numerical checks are corroborative, not infinite proofs. Priority assessment is limited to inspected sources and semantic searches.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns stationary-in-time observations of noninteracting Rabi spins with complete synchronized Poisson resetting, fixed Hamiltonian parameters and an immediate projective readout; no interacting system, time-uniform limit, or finite-time many-body behavior is proved. The first fixed-rate covariance and quantum renewal structure are prior results. A possible equivalent specialization of a general rare-event mixture theorem remains a priority risk.
title: A mixed-Poisson Zeno crossover under common quantum resetting
